blocks: You can view your basic player info (Sung Jinwoo info) and set visual aspects of your profile here.
This is also the place to check your Ranking Achievement info and your progress in various game modes.
[How to Access Your Profile]
- [Lobby] ▶ [Nickname] icon in the top left corner
- [Menu] ▶ [Profile]
[Profile Info - Main Page]
- You can set your profile icon and icon frame here.
- You can change your public nickname by clicking on your current nickname and consuming currency.
- You can edit your profile info through the [Profile Edit] button located on the bottom left of the screen.
- This is the place to view your Reputation Level and statistics.
- You can also view your drawn hunters, completed achievements, challenge medals and your total number of game logins here.
- This menu will also display your public-facing introductory message. If you haven't set one, a default introduction
will be displayed.
- You can see other players' guild information.
*This guide was written based on a test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

blocks: When your main party's Total Power reaches a certain threshold, you can increase your Battle Class tier and earn an Achievement Reward.
[How to Access the Battle Class Menu]
- [Menu] ▶ [Battle Class]
- This menu unlocks upon clearing Chapter 8.
[Battle Class Guide]
- You can view your Battle Class tier here.
- The highest Total Power is calculated based on your team formation (in Sung Jinwoo Mode).
- Additional Total Power boosts, including those you receive from your Armory, are also reflected.
- You can also view Total Power you will need to reach the next Battle Class tier.
※ Total Power does not equal the sum of individual power values. It is calculated using a variable formula.
*This guide was written based on the test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

blocks: You can obtain rewards when you complete Achievements while playing the game.
[How to Access the Achievements List]
- [Menu] ▶ [Achievements]
[Achievement Missions Guide]
- There are 4 categories of Achievements: General, Collection, Growth, and Dungeon.
General
These Achievements are unlocked through normal game progression.
Collection
These Achievements are unlocked through collecting things like items and hunters.
Growth
These Achievements are unlocked by increasing the Total Power of Jinwoo,
the hunters, and the Shadow Soldiers.
Dungeon
These Achievements are unlocked by clearing levels in story chapters, gates, and other game
modes.
- You can obtain rewards when completing each Achievement Mission.
- There are a total of 3 Achievement Mission difficulties: gold, silver, and bronze. You can identify a mission's difficulty
by the trophy icon next to it.
- When one tier of an Achievement Mission is completed, it will unlock the next tier.
[Challenge Medals Guide]
- Unlocks upon clearing Chapter 14.
- You can view the amount of tokens you currently own and select which will be your Main Tokens.
- Tokens can be earned by completing various Challenge, Seasonal, and Rank missions.
- You can register up to 3 Main Tokens.
- In the details page, you can view the list of Tokens you own.
*This guide was written based on the test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

blocks: When you defeat monsters on the Special Commission list, you can obtain rewards
based on your number of kills.
[How to Access Special Commissions]
- [Menu] ▶ [Adventure Records] ▶ [Special Commission]
- Unlocks upon clearing Story Chapter 7-4 on Normal Mode.
[Special Commission Guide]
- You can view the Special Commission Monster list here.
- You can view your progress (kills, totals, etc.) for each monster on the list.
- Your progress gauge increases based on the number of monsters you kill.
- You can quickly move to the content where a specific monster can be found by using the 'Move' button
that accompanies the image of the monster.
- You can obtain rewards based on the progression of your Special Commissions.
- You can obtain additional rewards when completing a tier of a Commission.
[Special Commission Level Up]
- You can view the maximum level of the Special Commission for each monster
by tapping the associated Monster icon.
- The kill count is cumulative.
[Special Commission Reward]
- Rewards are given once per tier, and rewards you have already obtained cannot be obtained again.
*This guide was written based on the test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

blocks: Options allows you to change the settings for the game's graphics, sound, language, controls, and more.
[How to Access Options]
- [Menu] ▶ [Gear] icon on the bottom right
[Graphics]
- Use these settings to change the quality and resolution of the game's visuals, including how certain effects are rendered.
[Sound]
- Use these settings to change the individual volume levels of the background music, sound effects, and dialogue.
[Language Settings]
- Use these settings to change which language is used for in-game text and for voiceovers.
- 13 in-game text languages are supported, and voiceovers are available in Korean, Japanese, and English.
[Control Settings]
- Use these settings to customize the controls for attacking, movement, and camera motion.
- You must hit [Save] after binding the keys to apply your selections.
- You can reset the key bindings by using the [Reset to Default] button.
- Scroll down! Camera and control methods can be customized for each battle mode!
[Game Settings]
- Use the On/Off button to toggle the navigation display for Challenges.
- You can also activate a 'Lock' function to prevent mistakes in selling or salvaging SSR weapons.
[Account Settings]
- Here, you can view your account details, such as which external accounts you have linked to your game account, and which game version you have downloaded.
- You can also log into another game account by logging out.
- You can also delete game accounts using the account deletion function. When this function is used, there will be a 30-day grace period,
after which all game-related account data will be deleted and cannot be recovered.
- Questions regarding general game-related issues can be submitted to customer support.
- You can view the Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, and User Agreement through each button.
- A page where you can enter coupon codes is provided.
- You can also view the amount of paid versus free Diamonds you have.
*This guide was written based on the test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

blocks: In the Sung Jinwoo menu, you can view and change Jinwoo's battle stats, skills, gear, and more.
[How to Access the Sung Jinwoo Menu]
- [Menu] ▶ [Sung Jinwoo]
[Sung Jinwoo Guide]
- In this menu, you can view Jinwoo's stats.
- Stat points Jinwoo has obtained through leveling up can be invested in his different stats.
- You can view detailed information about each stat by tapping the magnifying glass icon.
- Jinwoo's current Job and the conditions for his next Job Change can also be seen here.
- After reaching the max level, additional Sung Jinwoo EXP is converted to Reputation Level EXP.
[Presets]
- You can view the items Sung Jinwoo has equipped in the selected preset.
- Only Jinwoo's equipment information can be edited. See the specified area.
*When editing Sung Jinwoo Weapons, skills, or Blessing Stones, changes will only apply to the selected preset.
- Tap the magnifying glass button to move to the page where you can edit the presets.
- Tap the filter located next to the Preset button to select a formation tag.
- You can create formation tags by going to [Menu] ▶ [Manage Presets],
and the tags you create will show as active in the tag selection pop-up.
- When you select a tag and tap the Change button, presets that match the condition will be filtered and displayed.
Stats Effects
Strength
Increases Jinwoo's basic attack
Vitality
Increases Jinwoo's HP and Defense
Agility
Increases Jinwoo's Critical Hit damage
Intelligence
Increases MP
Perception
Increases Precision, and increases minimum damage dealt to enemies
[Jinwoo's Dossier]
- You can view Jinwoo's character dossier here.
[Costumes]
- You can view and change Jinwoo's costume here.
[Skills]
- You can set the skill Jinwoo's equipped skills here.
- You can strengthen his skills by leveling them up and equipping runes through this menu.

- When you obtain a high-grade Skill Rune of the same type, any lower-grade Skill Rune already registered will automatically be upgraded to the higher grade. Same or lower-grade Skill Rune duplicates obtained after will be sent to your inventory.
- Skill Runes sent to your inventory can be used to fuse.
[Artifacts]
- Jinwoo can equip artifacts.
- You can view the effects of the artifacts Jinwoo has equipped.
- Use Unequip All, Auto-Equip, or Advanced Settings to easily equip the most suitable artifacts.
- You can enhance an artifact by using the Enhance button.
- An Artifact Enhancement Chip will be used when you enhance an artifact.
[Blessing Stones]
- You can set the Jinwoo's Blessing Stones here.

- When you obtain a high-grade Blessing Stone of the same type, any lower-grade Blessing Stone already registered will automatically be upgraded to the higher grade. Same or lower-grade Blessing Stone duplicates obtained after will be sent to your inventory. Blessing Stones sent to your inventory can be used to fuse.
*This guide was written based on the test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

blocks: Change job
You can awaken new abilities for Jinwoo by unlocking and completing a Job Change Test.
When Jinwoo's Job tier is upgraded, you can obtain rewards such as a character appearance change, new skills, and new Blessing Stones.
[How to Access the Change job Menu]
- [Menu] ▶ [Sung Jinwoo] ▶ The Circular [Job Emblem]
[Job Change Conditions and Rewards]

Change Job Rewards
- A new appearance, new skills, new Blessing Stones, Stat Points, and more!

blocks: You can level up Jinwoo's skills and equip them with Skill Runes to make them even more powerful.
[How to Access Jinwoo's Skills]
- [Menu] ▶ [Sung Jinwoo] ▶ Tap the [Skill] icon on the left side of the screen
- [Menu] ▶ [Sung Jinwoo] ▶ Tap the [Skill] tab on the right side of the screen
[Skills Guide]
- Jinwoo can have a total of 3 skills equipped at once.
- By equipping a skill with one of its specific skill runes,
you can transform it from a basic skill or QTE Skill into a more powerful Rune Skill.
- Each rune has different effects and attributes.
- You can see an equipped rune's type, element, and Break effectiveness by looking at the Skill icon.
- The [Change Rune] feature becomes available after clearing Chapter 4.
- You can also view the skill effects.
*This guide was written based on a test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

blocks: You can view the cosmetics you've collected, the BGM files you've unlocked, and Story codex entries you've collected here. You can customize the lobby background music and your character's appearance to your liking by browsing each list and create an atmosphere that's uniquely yours.
[How to Access Collection]
- [Menu] ▶ [Collection]
- [Lobby] ▶ [BGM Codex]
- [Lobby] ▶ [Story Codex]
[Costume/Skin Codex]
- The Cosmetic Codex contains the following categories: Cosmetic Shop, Hunter, Weapon, and Costume Parts.
- In the Costume Shop, you can purchase a variety of unique and stylish costume packs.
- In the Hunters and Weapons section, you can view the skins you own and equip the ones you prefer.
- In the Costume Parts menu, you can switch between the different hairstyle and face accessories you own.
- Chromas can be used to recolor the costumes you own and equip them.
[Costume Parts]
- The Costume Parts page allows you to check which hairstyle and face accessories you own and switch to the parts you want.
- Costume Parts are character-specific items and can only be equipped by that specific character.
*Certain costumes may limit your ability to equip certain hairstyles and face accessories.
[Costume Chroma Guide]
- Chromas are only available for costumes that have the Chroma icon.
- You can purchase chromas using Chroma Ampoules.
*If you don't own the costume, a chroma for it cannot be applied.
[BGM Codex]
- The BGM Codex allows you to replay lobby, event, in-game (dungeon) background music tracks, and select any songs you have collected to set as the Hunters Association lobby background music.
*The BGM Codex page shows the list of BGMs and how to obtain them.
*Choose any track to repeat or add it to your favorites, and when applied, it will play in the Hunters Association lobby.
[Story Codex]
- The Story Codex is where you can view cinematics, webtoons and illustrations you have unlocked.
- Entries are unlocked sequentially as you advance through the story and meet certain requirements.
- You can earn rewards based on your collection completion progression for each category. Collection Milestones may be expanded when new content is added.
- Use the Entry Progress Gauge to track your current progress, and tap the magnifying glass icon to preview the reward details.
- Use the Go feature in the content details pop-up to jump directly to where the corresponding story takes place.
*This guide was written based on the test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

blocks: Hunters are support characters that help Jinwoo when playing through the Story and Gates game modes.
In other game modes, you can play as a party exclusively comprised of these same hunters.
[How to Access the Hunters Menu]
- [Menu] ▶ [Hunters]
[Hunters Guide]
Here, you can:
- View the list of hunters you own.
- View the appearance of the selected hunter.
- View the detailed stats of that hunter.
- View their passives.
- View the equipment they have equipped.
- View their artifacts and skills.
- Use the filter function on the hunter list.
- View the dossier of the selected hunter.
[Hunter Rankings & Attributes]
All hunters have attributes and a hunter rank.
The rank won't change, even when a hunter is leveled up.

[Hunter Class]
- Striker: An offensive class focused on dealing heavy damage
- Breaker: A control class that brings down enemies with Break damage
- Supporter: A support class that assists allies or team members in battle
- Elemental Stacker: An element-specialized class that triggers Element Overload through Elemental Charge
- Elemental Buster: A burst-damage class that deals massive damage to Overloaded targets.

[Hunter Level Ups]
- You can use currency to level up a hunter.
- Hunters can only be leveled up to the same level as Sung Jinwoo.
- Hunters' stats increase when leveling up.
[Hunter Advancement]
- When you obtain a duplicate hunter, you obtain that hunter's Data.
In combination with currency, that Data can be used to Advance hunters.
- All hunters obtain a unique passive at each tier of advancement.
- Hunters can be advanced to tier 5, and after that, they can be advanced to dimensional advancement tier 5.
[Hunter Upgrade]
- This feature becomes available when you own a hunter level 40 or higher.
- You can consume materials to perform a Hunter Upgrade.
- Upgrades can be performed up to 15 times per hunter.
- Upgrading greatly increases a hunter's basic stats.
[Hunter Skills]
- Each hunter has unique skills.
- When acquiring a hunter, all skills start at Lv. 1.
- The max level of a hunter's skill is determined by the hunter's current level.
*A fully leveled-up hunter's skills can be leveled up to level 10.
- You can increase each skill level by using Skill Scrolls.
[Hunter Artifacts]
- Each hunter can equip artifacts.
- Use Unequip All, Auto-Equip, or Advanced Settings to easily equip the most suitable artifacts.
- You can enhance an artifact by using the Enhance button.
- An Artifact Enhancement Chip is consumed when enhancing an artifact.
- When you enter the Skill Guide below, you can view each hunter's Passive and recommended Skill Level Up sequence/Skill use order.
*This guide was written based on the test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

blocks: Weapons are divided into player weapons and hunter weapons.
Player weapons possess exclusive skills that Sung Jinwoo uses.
There are weapons that can be shared between hunters, and there are also weapons that are exclusive to specific hunters.
[How to Access Weapons]
- [Menu] ▶ [Weapons]
[Weapon Guide]
- Weapons have elemental attributes.
- Sung Jinwoo's second weapon slot is unlocked after he changes his job to Night Lord.
Elemental Attributes
Fire
Water
Wind
Light
Dark
- Bosses have strengths in certain attributes. When attacking a boss with the specific attribute that is its
Strength Attribute, you deal 50% less damage.
- On the other hand, if you target the boss' Weakness Attribute, your attack will deal 150% increased damage.
- If you carefully consider the weapons, skills, and attributes of your hunters before fighting the boss, it'll make
the fight easier.
[Exclusive Weapons]
- Hunters gain additional passive effects when they equip their exclusive weapon.
- There's one hunter-exclusive weapon for each hunter.
[Weapon Level Up & Limit Break]
- Use Weapon Enhancement Gear items to enhance a weapon.
- You can limit break at level 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, and 110.
- When a weapon has been limit broken, the weapon's max level is increased, and it can be leveled up
additional times.
[Weapon Advancement]
- If you own duplicate weapons, you can use them as materials to advance a weapon.
- You can advance a weapon up to 10 times.
- Advancement costs are higher the higher the weapon's grade of advancement is.
[Weapon Skill Level Up]
- You can level up the player (Sung Jinwoo) weapon's skill.
- Player Skill Scrolls are required when leveling up a skill.
- You can only level up skills when you meet the conditions for each skill.
- You can view how a weapon skill is used through the Preview button.
[Salvaging Weapons]
- Any unlocked weapons, regardless of type, can be salvaged.
- You can obtain various materials, including Weapon Enhancement Gear, from salvaging weapons.
*This guide was written based on the test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

blocks: Artifacts are items that both Jinwoo and the other hunters can equip.
You can increase an artifact's supporting stats and enhancement level through engraving and enhancement.
You can obtain additional stats when equipping artifacts in a matching set.
[How to Access the Artifacts Menu]
- [Menu] ▶ [Artifacts]
[Artifacts Guide]
- This content becomes available upon completing Chapter 5, Episode 1 "The Hidden Quest".
- Necklaces and bracelets are unlocked after completing Chapter 9. Rings and earrings are unlocked after completing Chapter 12.
- Additional effects are applied depending on the number of artifacts in a set equipped.
Here, you can:
- View the list of artifacts you own as well as which ones Jinwoo and the other hunters have equipped.
- Sort the artifacts by using the filter function.
- Lock artifacts to prevent them from accidentally being used as a material component.
- View artifact information and stats.
- Enhance artifacts.
[Artifact Enhancement]
- You can increase the stats of an artifact by enhancing it.
- Use the [Auto-Enhance] button to enhance an artifact until it reaches the target enhancement level.
- The bonus rate will increase by 1% with each enhancement failure.
- At enhancement tiers 5, 10, 15, and 20, one additional supporting stat will be added.
- The number of starting supporting stats will vary depending on the item's rarity.
When enhancement is successful and supporting stats aren't added through enhancement, the value of
a random one of the current supporting stats will increase.
- The accumulated bonus rate will reset upon successful enhancement.
[Artifact Enchantment]
- You can select a substat of your choice and further increase its stats.
- The value of the bonus added to a substat is determined randomly based on set rates.
*If you attempt to enchant more than once and if the newly granted substat
isn't higher than the existing substat, it will not be saved and you'll keep the existing substat.
- Use the [Continuous Enchantment] button to automatically enchant
until the substat reaches the maximum level.
- Material items and Gold will be consumed when you enchant.
*There's a different minimum and maximum value range for each material item.
[Reforging Artifacts]
- You can reforge the artifacts you own to increase their stats.
- When reforging an artifact, you can check what the new stat values and Equipment Score will be.
*The artifact's Enhancement Tier will be carried over when reforging, and the Enchantment stats will remain unchanged.
*The artifact's effect type will not change even after reforging.
- You can reforge Heroic - Legendary grade artifacts above a certain level once per artifact.
*Artifacts that do not meet the conditions won't be displayed on the Reforge List.
*Event artifacts are excluded from the Reforge List.
- The Reforge Stone items and Gold required to reforge differ by grade,
and the actual items consumed will be displayed on the screen.
*The button will display only when the reforge conditions are met. (Each artifact can be reforged only once.)
*You can view the stats that will be changed and the materials that will be consumed before reforging.
*This guide was written based on the test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

blocks: Jinwoo's Shadow Soldiers are loyal subordinates who become an important source of power for him.
Use the Summon skill to summon the Army of Shadows in battle.
[How to Access Army of Shadows Menu]
- [Menu] ▶ [Army of Shadows]
- Unlocks upon clearing Chapter 9.
[Army of Shadows]
- You can view the level and Total Power of your Army of Shadows here.
- When you select a Shadow Soldier, you can view the detailed stats of that Shadow Soldier.
[Unlocking & Extracting Shadows]
- After clearing a certain stage and acquiring the necessary number of Traces of Shadow,
you can obtain a Shadow Soldier and their associated troops.
- You can view the effects of their skills after summoning them,
and see what it will take to promote them.
[Army Level & Total Power]
- The bonuses gained from the overall army level and Total Power are applied to all Shadow Soldiers equally.
[Shadow Growth]
- You can strengthen extracted Shadows.
- When you level up your Army of Shadows, all the Shadow Soldiers are affected.
- The power of your Shadow Soldiers can be increased through Army of Shadows Growth and individual Shadow Growth.
- You can increase the Total Power of your Army of Shadows by leveling up your army as a whole or upgrading
Shadows individually.
- Each Shadow can grow stronger through Promotions.
[Army of Shadows Growth: Level Up]
- You can level up your Army of Shadows by consuming Shadow Energy.
- Your Army's Total Power increases based on your Army of Shadows level.
[Shadow Growth: Upgrade]
- When upgrading a Shadow Soldier, you need Abyssal Fragments, Abyssal Energy, Abyssal Essence, and Gold.
Upgrading an individual Shadow Soldier can increase your Army's Total Power.
[Shadow Growth: Promotion]
- When promoting a Shadow Soldier, you need Traces of Shadow and Gold.
Your maximum army level will increase and the selected Shadow Soldier will gain additional skills.
- The Shadow can obtain more skills when it reaches a certain promotion tier.
- The Shadow's appearance will change when it reaches a certain promotion tier.
[Shadow Armament]
- Shadow Armaments can be activated individually. When a Shadow reaches General rank, their special Armament becomes available for activation.
- You can check the Details menu to learn what materials are required to activate the Shadow's Armament.
- Shadow Armaments offer stat boosts for your Shadows, an increase to your Army's Total Power, an Armament Skill, and Armament Effects.
[Shadow Armament: Advancement]
- The Shadow Armament can be advanced up to five times.
- As it advances to higher tiers, the materials required to continue advancing may vary.
- Each time you advance an Armament it increases the Shadow's stat bonuses, your Army's Total Power, and the Armament Effects.
[Leveling Up Shadow Skills]
- You can level up a Shadow's skill once the Shadow is promoted to Elite rank.
- Leveling up a Shadow's skill enhances the skill and increases the Army of Shadows' Total Power.
- Skills can be leveled up to Lv. 5 maximum when a Shadow reaches Elite rank and Lv. 10 maximum when they reach Elite Knight.
[Shadow Stories]
- Tap the [Book-shaped] icon on each Shadow Soldier's page to view their backstory.
[Using Shadows]
- When forming a team with your Shadows, the power of the Shadow assigned to the leader position (first slot)
is applied to the entire team.
- Up to three Shadows can be assigned to your team, accompanied by their respective squads. When you summon
your army, all the Shadows on your team will appear and join the battle.
*This guide was written based on the test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

blocks: When playing through the story, tackling a gate, fighting the Guild Boss, or taking on
other content, you can switch to already formed decks, so you can load your presets and begin playing.
[How to Access Manage Presets]
- [Menu] ▶ [Strategy Training] ▶ [Manage Presets]
[Preset Guide]
- You can view the Total Power of the deck you've formed here.
- You can also create and edit the preset name and formation tag.
*The formation tags you created will show as active in the tag selection pop-up on the Sung Jinwoo Page.
- Each mode, inclusive of Player/Hunter/Guild Boss modes, can have its own presets.
- You can create 20 presets in Player and Hunter Modes and 10 presets in Guild Boss Mode.
- You can determine the settings for Jinwoo, your hunters, your Army of Shadows, and your Remnant Power.
- When overwriting, the formation information modified on the Formation page is saved to the preset list.
- When loading, the information saved in the preset list is copied to the Formation page.
- In Edit Mode you can modify each formation, delete or change the preset list (move up/down), or enter Copy Mode.
- In Copy Mode, you can select Sung Jinwoo/Hunter/Army of Shadows/Remnant Power info and add it to a different Preset List.
[Auto-Form]
- Before entering a stage in Story, Gate, Guild Boss, or other game mode, you can use ""Auto-Form""
to automatically load a formation with hunters, Shadows, and Remnant Power.
- When using Auto-Form, the hunters with the highest Total Power are set first.
*This guide was written based on the test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

blocks: Story mode is a game mode that allows you to play through dungeon and story chapters based on the original webtoon.
You can obtain various rewards and strengthen your characters by clearing chapters.
[How to Access the Story]
- [Lobby] ▶ [Compass] ▶ [Story]
- [Menu] ▶ [Game Modes] ▶ [Story]
[Story Guide]
- There are two types of stories: Main Stories that follow Jinwoo's journey, and Side Stories that follow his hunter allies
on their own journeys.
[Story Difficulty]
- Difficulty levels are separated into Normal, Hard, and Expert.
- Hard difficulty unlocks after clearing Chapter 7-6 on Normal difficulty.
- Expert difficulty unlocks after clearing Chapter 25 on Hard difficulty.
[Main Story]
- Main Story chapters are about Sung Jinwoo.
- You can play the next chapter after clearing all the stages in the previous chapter.
[Side Story]
- Play through the story using hunters other than Sung Jinwoo.
- In each different Side Story, you must play as the hunter that the chapter is about.
[Battle Missions]
- For dungeon chapters, there are optional battle missions for each stage, and you can obtain rewards upon
completing them.
- You can clear the stage by defeating the boss even if you don't complete the battle missions.
[Reverse Mode]
- Unlocks after clearing Chapter 15.
- This mode allows you to play a version of the main story chapters with support hunters instead of Jinwoo.
- Use the Reverse button in Story Mode to switch to Reverse Mode.
- Reverse Mode features its own Battle Missions.
[Special Stage]
- Special Stage is a game mode designed to help you identify the unique patterns of the main bosses representing each episode and focus on gaining combat experience.
- You can view Special Stages by expanding the Act and can attempt them by fulfilling the requirements.
- There is a Total Power cap in order to maintain the thrill of boss battles. If the Team Total Power exceeds this cap when entering the battle, it may be adjusted to match the cap.
- Clear Rewards are only granted once on the first clear, but you can continue to enjoy the boss battle through unrestricted retries.
*This guide was written based on the test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

blocks: In the Gate, you can defeat monsters and obtain materials needed for growth.
[How to Access Gates]
- [Lobby] ▶ [Compass] on the right side of the screen ▶ [Gate] on the left side of the screen

blocks: Drawing allows you to obtain powerful hunters and weapons.
[How to Access the Draw]
- [Lobby] ▶ [Ticket] icon
- [Lobby] ▶ [Draw] (NPC Lim Hajin)
- Available after clearing Chapter 1.
[Draw Guide]
- Character Draw: Here, you can draw a specific hunter at a high acquisition rate.
- Custom Draw: This is a draw that allows you to set a Rate Up List.
- The Draw Support gauge increases by 1 every time you draw.
- The Draw Support gauge resets when you obtain an SSR.
- When you draw while your Draw Support gauge is full, you're guaranteed to obtain 1 SSR
and the gauge will be reset.
- You can view the appearance rates of each reward before drawing.
- You can view your draw history through Draw History button.
- You can also see how many of the required Draw Tickets you have.
- Rate Up Draw Tickets are required for Rate Up draws, and Custom Draw Ticket are required for custom draws.
- Rate Up hunters may be added to the Selection Draw list.
[Rate Up Draw Support]
- After the Rate Up period for a specific hunter ends, the final SSR acquisition support rate
will be maintained even when the Rate Up for the next hunter begins.
- An SSR is guaranteed within 70 draws, and that count (your Draw Support gauge) is reset upon SSR acquisition.
- Starting from the 60th draw of the Draw Support, the SSR draw rate increases by 5.8%
each time.
- When acquiring SSRs through Draw Support:
1) There is a 50% chance of drawing the "Rate Up SSR Hunter."
2) The remaining 50% chance is divided by 1/N among the SSRs on the list, excluding
the "Rate Up SSR Hunter."
- If an SSR is acquired through Draw Support but not the "Rate Up SSR Hunter," there is
a 100% chance of acquiring the "Rate Up SSR Hunter" in the next Draw Support.
[Collaboration Rate Up Draw]
- During the collaboration period, Rate Up Draw will operate under rules separate from the existing Rate Up Draw system and Rate Up Draw Support.
- During the collaboration period, obtaining an SSR Hunter through Rate Up Draw will guarantee a 100% draw rate for the featured SSR Hunter.
- The number of accumulated Rate Up Draw Support attempts during the collaboration period will be reset when the Rate Up Draw ends.
[Custom Draw - List]
- This function increases the appearance rate of selected SSRs.
- You can change the custom list at any time.
- An SSR is guaranteed within 70 draws, and that count (your Draw Support gauge) is reset upon SSR acquisition.
- After the Draw Support count reaches 60, the SSR appearance rate increases by 5.8% for each draw.
- When obtaining an SSR through Draw Support,
there is a 50% chance to draw one of your 3 selected SSRs by a rate of 1/N.
The other 50% is divided among the remaining SSRs on the list, excluding the 3 selected SSRs, by a rate of 1/N.
- If the SSR you obtain through Draw Support is not on your Selection List, there's a 1/N chance to obtain 1 of the 3 SSRs on the Selection List on your next Draw Support attempt.
*This guide was written based on the test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

[Fuse Guide]
- You can select the Skill Runes or Blessing Stones you want to fuse.
- Information about the fusion progress will be displayed.
- You can view the odds of the fusion being successful or very successful.
- The numbers after the third decimal place are rounded up.
- If the fusion is very successful, the result will be a higher-grade item. If the fusion is successful, the same grade item
will appear as the result.
- The magnifying glass icon will show you what the results might look like when you achieve a Successful or
Very Successful fusion.
- You can view the number of Fusion Points required to guarantee a Very Successful result.
- When you attempt a fusion, you obtain Fusion Points.
- When the fusion is Very Successful, the Fusion Point gauge is reset to 0.
- When the Fusion Point gauge is full, the next fusion will be Very Successful.
- Gold is deducted when fusing.
- You can manually register the items that will be used as fusion materials or automatically register them through
Simple Fusion.
- Rune Fragments are used as materials for runes and Powder of Blessings is used as a material for Blessing Stones.
Items of the same grade can also be used as materials.
- You can enable the Color Selection option when fusing gems.
- When enabled, the fused gem will retain the same color as the gem used as fusion material.
- Fusion Points are accumulated separately for the Color Selection On/Off option.
[Skill Rune / Blessing Stone Refinement Guide]
- Use duplicate Legendary Skill Runes and Blessing Stones to set a Refinement Goal.
*You can only select Legendary Skill Runes/Blessing Stones you don't have as the Refinement Goal.
- Information about the refinement process will be displayed.
- You can view the Refinement Successful and Very Successful rate.
- When it's Very Successful, the Refinement Goal will appear, and if it's Successful, a target with the same grade will appear.
- You can check the result for Successful and Very Successful in View Rates.
*Values are rounded to the second decimal place.
- You can view the number of Refinement Points required to guarantee a Very Successful result.
- You will obtain 1 Refinement Point when attempting refinement.
- The Refinement Point will reset to 0 when the refinement is Very Successful.
- When the Refinement Point gauge is full, the next refinement will be Very Successful.
- When refining, specific currency will be deducted as a fee.
*If you own all Legendary Skill Runes and Blessing Stones, the Refinement feature will be unavailable,
and will reopen again when new Skill Runes and Blessing Stones become available later.
[Gem Refinement Guide]
- Rank 6 Gems with B-Tier or lower stats can be refined into A-Tier Gems with the same stats.
*You must have a Rank 6 Gem/B-Tier or lower gem in your inventory to set or change the Refinement Goal.
*Gems equipped on the gem page cannot be used as refinement material.
- Refining gems consumes Essence Stones. If you don't obtain your Refinement Goal during any given attempt, you'll accumulate points.
- When your point gauge is full, you're guaranteed to obtain the gem you set as your Refinement Goal for the next refinement.
*If you achieve a Very Successful refinement and obtain the gem you set as your Refinement Goal, the point gauge will be reset.

blocks: Battlefield of Time is a "time attack" game mode where you defeat a designated boss and minions as quickly as possible.

[Seasons]
'- Each season lasts 5 weeks (4 play weeks + 1 calculation week), and a total of 4 bosses will appear.
- The displayed button's information changes depending on the season's schedule.
1) Available Soon: Displays the time remaining until the challenge period opens.
2) In Progress: You can challenge the boss and register your record.
3) Calculations in progress: The challenge period has ended, and the calculations for overall rank and group rank for each boss are in progress.
4) Expired: Calculations have concluded and rewards can be claimed.
- Here, you can see how much time remains in the season and view which boss stages are available.
- You can view which stages you have already cleared and which rank you have cleared them at.
- You can also view which rewards are available by stage clear time.
You can obtain all the top Achievement Rewards by clearing a stage within 1 minute and 30 seconds.
- You can also view your Boss Stage Clear record and rank.
*The Battlefield of Time has its own balance system, and certain effects, such as Figures and Guild Potion buffs, do not apply.
[Time Records]
- To ensure fairness, the time that the game was paused and the time it takes skill animations to activate are included
in the play time calculation in Battlefield of Time mode.
[Rankings]
- Overall Rank: You can obtain rewards at the end of the season based on your group rank.
- Achievement Reward: You can obtain rewards immediately upon achieving clear conditions.
- The total Season Points you earn from the 4 bosses will determine your season rank.
- You can claim your final calculated reward for each boss automatically by accessing the boss page after the season calculation.

[Power of Calamity Rankings]

- Rank Rewards are distributed after the weekly ranking calculation.
*Rank Rewards for any given week can only be claimed during the next week's time period; they cannot be claimed after that.
*All weekly rewards are distributed upon entering the Power of Calamity lobby.
*Season Rank Points are automatically calculated regardless of whether or not you enter the Power of Calamity lobby.
- Season Rankings: As a season-based ranking, you can claim rewards upon entering the Power of Calamity lobby after calculations for the final week of the season have been completed.
*Rank Rewards can only be claimed during the next season following the end of the current season; they cannot be claimed after that.
*Season Rankings are calculated by totaling the Season Rank Points earned each week, and all the points you own are reset upon the end of the season.
- Solo Challenge (Point Tier) Rewards: Rewards are immediately granted based on the highest score you recorded when point conditions were met.
*Gameplay is restricted every Wednesday from 23:50~00:00(UTC) to ensure stable ranking calculations.
- If you're already playing the game, you'll be automatically kicked out.
[Power of Calamity Formation]

[Power of Calamity Conquest Proficiency / Support]

- Use the [Confirm] button to set the desired number of Conquest Support effects.
- Conquest Support effects can be applied multiple times when forming Team 1 and Team 2.
- You can play Power of Calamity without additionally setting Conquest Support.
- Conquest Proficiency is calculated based on Sung Jinwoo's weapon and hunter advancement tier.
- You can view the detailed stats applied to each proficiency tier in the Conquest Loadout Effects page.
[Power of Calamity Records]
- Before the weekly calculation starts, you can reset the records you've recorded with each team, reform your teams, and try again.

*A certain amount of currency is consumed when creating a guild.

[Guild Lobby Guide]
1. Guild Exchange Shop: Check the Guild Content Guide for more information.
[Go to Guild Content Game Guide]
2. You can perform guild tasks such as Guild Check-Ins and Guild Management through the Guild NPC.
- Decorate Lobby: The Guild Master can decorate the Guild Lobby through Guild Management.
- Guild Information
1) You can view basic guild information, guild member details, Contribution Points, notices, and more here.
2) You can check the EXP required to level up the guild as well. The maximum number of guild members you can have increases as your Guild Level increases.
*You can view detailed information about the benefits of leveling up the guild under [Guild Information] ▶ [Guild Level].
3) Regular guild members can leave the guild. The Vice Guild Master and Guild Managers can leave
only after being demoted to a regular Guild Member.
4) The Guild Master can disband the guild. If they want to leave, they can transfer the Guild Master privileges to another hunter,
get demoted to a Regular Guild Member, and then leave.
*If you leave a guild, you'll be penalized and will not be able to rejoin for a certain period of time.
*If you disband your guild, you will be subject to a penalty period and will not be able to create or join a new guild for a certain period of time.
*A guild can only be disbanded when the Guild Master is the only member.
*If the Guild Master is absent for 14 consecutive days, Guild Master privileges will be transferred to the Vice Guild Master
who has logged in most recently. (If there are no guild members except the Guild Master, the guild will remain as-is.)
*If there is no Vice Guild Master, privileges will be transferred to the guild member who has logged in most recently.
*Only guild members who have checked in for 10 days or more are eligible.
5) You can check guild members' Status History.
*The history goes back 7 days and will be completely deleted after.
- Guild Management
1) This menu is only available to the Guild Master and Vice Guild Master.
2) You can kick certain guild members and invite new ones.
* If you are expelled from a guild, or if you leave or disband a guild,
a penalty will be imposed that prevents you from rejoining a new guild for 24 hours.
* A penalty will be imposed that prevents the creation of a new guild for 72 hours after a guild is disbanded.
* The amount of "Guild Coins" you hold will be retained even if you are expelled or leave the guild.
3) You can only kick out guild members that are lower than you in rank.
4) You cannot invite hunters who are already part of a guild.
5) The Guild Master has the privilege to approve hunters' requests to join the guild.
- Guild Privileges: The Guild Master has all the available privileges and can transfer them to other hunters.
- External Community Integration
1) The Guild Master can register an external community URL under [Guild Management] ▶ [Guild] ▶ [Notices].
2) All guild members can access the registered community by tapping the Community icon at the bottom of [Guild Information].
3) Only the Guild Master can register and manage the community. These permissions are also transferred when Guild Master authority is delegated to another member.
4) When a guild is disbanded, its registered community information will also be deleted.
3. Mini Game: Enjoy the mini games!
4. Guild Members: The avatars of guild members who meet certain conditions appear in the Guild Lobby.
You can see their introductions by tapping on them.
5. Guild Missions: Complete Guild Missions to obtain currency.
6. Guild Boss: Fight the boss with your fellow guild members.
7. Guild Rank: Work with your fellow guild members to increase the Contribution Points, and obtain Honor and rewards.
*More Guild Lobby features may be added when your guild reaches higher levels,

[Guild Missions]

2) There are Daily, Weekly, and Co-Op Missions.
- Daily/Weekly Missions: Individual missions that grant instant rewards upon completion.
*Daily/Weekly Missions change depending on your Sung Jinwoo's level.
*The period from 1 hour before the weekly reset of guild missions
until the reset is designated as the settlement period,
during which mission rewards cannot be claimed.
Please ensure to claim your mission rewards before the settlement period begins.
7) When joining a new Guild (during the correspoding week), you are not able to participate in the ongoing Guild Boss content.

blocks: Unite with your fellow hunters to fight a threat that's shaken the world.
[How to Access the Guild Boss]

- [Lobby] > [Menu] in the upper right > [Guild] icon on the left side of the menu bar > [Boss Battle]
- [Game Modes] > [Weekly Missions] > [Guild Boss]
[Guild Boss]
1) Form a party with 6 hunters (excluding Shadows) and go into battle against the Guild Boss.
*Sung Jinwoo + 3 hunters in Team A + 3 hunters in Team B
*Each hunter's passive team buff effects are only applied to hunters within the formed team,
but the area-of-effect skill buffs are applied to all hunters.
*Hunters will not use QTEs or Support Skills.
*When a hunter falls in combat, they're out of the battle.
2) Battles can be carried out between two groups, and the scores of each group will be automatically recorded at the end.
*You can reselect a group that has already fought and have them try again.
*If you achieve a higher score than before, the score is automatically updated. The update is based on your Rage Count and your overall score.
*When retrying, a group that has already been formed cannot be changed until the formation and records are reset.
3) Hunters already assigned to another group cannot be placed in multiple groups.
4) The highest scores achieved by the two groups are added together for calculation at the end.
*After a reset, each group must complete a battle at last 1 time during the season for the scores to be recorded again.
*If the season ends during the challenge, the score may not be recorded.
5) Rage Reward can be obtained all at once for all rewards up to the number of rages achieves at the end of battle.
6) New guild members cannot participate in an ongoing Guild Boss battle.
7) If unusual play is detected, the challenge results will not be processed and rewards will not be granted.
8) Any unclaimed rewards will be mailed to you when the season is renewed.
9) Recommended elements for tackling the Guild Boss are displayed as Fixed Elements and Dynamic Elements.
*Dynamic Elements can change each season, serving as a reference for your seasonal strategies.
*Guild Boss attempts are disabled from 1 hour before the season reset until the reset time.
[The All-Out Guild War]
1) Only guilds with a rank of D3 or higher can participate in the All-Out Guild War.
2) If you qualify, you can form a 5-guild group with your guild and four others for the All-Out Guild War every week.
3) Based on your total Rage Count, you can claim rewards on the All-Out War screen by clicking (tapping) them.
*When the All-Out War season resets the Accumulated Points Rewards and the points you have acquired will be reset.
*You can obtain the reward for the highest section within the season.
*If the All-Out War season resets
before you claim your Accumulated Rage Reward, your unclaimed rewards will be sent to your mailbox.
*The Accumulated Rage Reward can be obtained based on the Guild Boss Rage Count that was applied.
4) The All-Out War Rank is determined based on the Guild Boss Rage Count,
and depending on the rank and your personal Rage Count, you can obtain a Contribution Reward.
*If two players have the same Rage Count, the rank will be determined based on the total damage dealt.
5) You can obtain the Contribution Reward after the All-Out Guild War seasonal settlement and by tapping the Last Rank button.
*Scores and reward details will not be shown if there's no participation record from the previous season.
6) In the All-Out War Rank screen, you can view the detailed information, including Guild Name/Rage Count/Score/Attempts.
7) Tap the Guild Contribution Info (magnifying glass) button in the All-Out Guild War screen
to view the contribution status of the guild members.
*Even if a guild members leaves, the information will be displayed until the next season.
※ New guild members cannot challenge the Guild Boss. Please participate from the next season.

[How to Access Cores]
- [Menu] ▶ [Core]

[Core Page Info]
Here, you can:
- View a list of all Cores that you own, as well as which ones Jinwoo and the other Hunters have equipped.
- Use the Filter feature to sort and arrange Cores.
- Lock Cores to prevent them from being accidentally used as an upgrade material.
- View a Core's stats and other information.
- Level up and enhance Cores.
[Core Level Up]
- You can level up Cores to enhance their 2 stats.
※ Unique passives are not affected by a Core's level.
- You can level up a core using [Cores] and [Growth Materials].
- Using limit broken cores as level up material transfers the Limit Break Tier.
*The transferred Limit Break Tier won't exceed the core used as material's Limit Break Tier.
*If the grade (rarity) of the core used as material is lower than the target core's grade, the Limit Break Tier will not be transferred.
*Using multiple limit broken cores as material will not transfer the Limit Break Tier multiple times. (Only the highest tier transfers)
*If EXP doesn't reach the next Limit Break point upon leveling up, the Limit Break Tier will not be transferred.
- The stat values will increase by random amounts within a set range at set probabilities upon leveling up.
- You can select up to 20 Cores at a time when leveling up.
[Core Enhancement]
- When a Core reaches its maximum level, [materials and currency] can be consumed to further enhance it.
- When you attempt to enhance a Core, one of its two stats will be selected at random to enhance.
- Once a stat reaches a specified limit, it can no longer be enhanced.
- Using "Instant Enhancement" skips the enhancement animation and reveals the results immediately.
*If you have insufficient materials or Gold, enhancement will proceed with the amount currently possessed.
[Core Limit Break]
- When a core has reached its maximum level and maximum Stat Enhancement Level, you can limit break it.
- When you limit break a core, its max level and stats will be expanded.
- There are Limit Break Tiers when limit breaking a core and the materials required for each tier may be different.

blocks: Remnant Powers are abilities absorbed from each Monarch
that can be strengthened by defeating them again and again.
Each Monarch's Remnant Power has a maximum enhancement level
that can be reached using Passive Points, which you can obtain each time you level up the remnant of a Monarch that you have defeated.
You can use these Passive Points to strategically develop your Remnant Powers
and they play a vital role in improving your Total Power and overall abilities.
The Remnant Power enhancement is divided into two parts: Skill Enhancement and Skill Advancement.
[How to Access Remnant Power]
- [Menu] ▶ [Legacy] ▶ [Remnant Power]
- Unlocks upon clearing Workshop of Brilliant Light Tier 1.
[Remnant Power]
- When you select each Monarch on the Remnant Power page, you can view their details, such as their remnant level and skills.
[Remnant Power Enhancement]
- You can enhance the Remnant Power of each Monarch using the Passive Points you obtained by leveling up.
*Use shared materials to level up.
- Remnant Power enhancement is divided into Skill Enhancement / Skill Advancement.
*You can consume currency to reset your Remnant Power enhancements.
- Use the Passive Points you obtain when leveling up a Remnant Power to enhance each trait.
*The number of Passive Points consumed for each trait is different.
- You must activate the enhancements in order.
[Skill Enhancement]
- This is a buff effect applied when entering battle if you have the associated Remnant Power equipped.

- Remnant Power Skill Enhancements can be all sorts of different buffs, and when you activate a Skill Enhancement of the same name in the Remnant Power menu, the performance of that existing enhancement increases.
[Skill Advancement]
- This is a skill effect that's applied when using a Remnant Power.
- When unlocking it for the first time, the basic skill effect is applied and each time you advance the skill, the skill effects and its animation evolve.
[Total Remnant Power]
- The Total Remnant Power is calculated by adding all the stat boosts
as each Monarch's remnant level increases.
- The Total Remnant Power is added to the team's Total Power when a Remnant Power is equipped.
- Your Total Remnant Power will influence your Battle Tier.
[Using Remnant Power]
- In the battle formation screen, you can select the Remnant Power you want to include in your formation.
*Cannot be used in certain game modes such as Edge of Illusion and Dreams and International Clash (PVP).
*This guide was written based on the test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

blocks: Accumulate Contribution Points by cooperating with the guild members
and increase your guild's rank to gain Honor and various rewards.
[Guild Rank]
1) A guild's rank increases based on its Contribution Points,
and a guild can be promoted when the required Contribution Points for the next applicable rank are acquired.
2) Promotions occur through the calculation process during the weekly reset
and upgrades are generally made one level at a time up to A1 Rank.
However, if a guild that was A1 Rank at the start of the season meets the S-Rank promotion conditions,
they can be promoted to any rank between S1 - S3 during the season calculation period based on the guild promotion rate of the guilds already in the S-Rank group.
3-1) When a guild reaches S-Rank, they will be given a sub-rank based on their contribution and top guild promotion rate.
*S1 Rank: Within Top 10% / S2 Rank: Above Top 10% - within 30% / S3 Rank: Above Top 30%
3-2) If the guild doesn't earn enough points to maintain their rank by the next calculation period, they will be demoted,
and if the guild earns enough points to maintain their rank, they will keep their current guild rank.
3-3) The guild's rank will increase when they achieve the points required to promote in addition to earning enough points to maintain their rank, applicable up to Rank A1.
3-4) If an S-Rank group earns enough points to maintain their rank,
they can be promoted to a rank between S1 - S3 based on their contribution earned that season and the top contribution percentages.
4) When you enter the guild lobby after your guild's rank has been calculated,
you'll obtain a Guild Rank Reward based on your guild's new rank.
5) If the guild does not have the points to maintain their rank during the calculation period, the guild will be demoted in rank.
*Guild Ranks are reset and calculated regularly every week.
[Rankings]
1) Ranks are determined within each ranking group based on each guild's cumulative contribution earned during a season.
2) The Top 5 ranked guilds in each group are displayed on the main screen,
and you can view your guild's rank information at the bottom.
3) If you tap the Guild Rank Info displayed at the bottom of the Guild Rank screen,
you can view the detailed rank information that will be reflected in the next season in the form of a tooltip.
The tooltip shows your guild's expected rank for the next season
based on the cumulative contribution the guild has earned so far this season,
and it will show the rank as increased/maintained/demoted.
*Up to A-Rank, the contribution points required for your guild's next promotion
are displayed as a gauge, allowing you to easily track your guild's progress.
*Starting from the S-Rank tiers, the indicator will change to simple icons that show whether your guild's rank will increase, maintain state, or decrease.

blocks: The Simulation Gate is a virtual world that connects reality to another dimension.
It's also a game mode where you can choose a difficulty level and challenge yourself to grow stronger.
[How to Access the Simulation Gate]
- [Lobby] ▶ [Simulation Gate]
- [Lobby] ▶ [Compass] ▶ [Weekly Missions] ▶ [Simulation Gate]
- [Menu] ▶ [Game Modes] ▶ [Weekly Missions] ▶ [Simulation Gate]
[Simulation Gate]
- In the Simulation Gate menu, you can view the game mode information and the Effect Amplification.
- You can view the Basic Score, Total Power, and the Reward Details for each tier.
- You can skip certain stages, and upon clearing the higher stage
you can obtain the first-time clear rewards and Battle Mission Rewards for skipped tiers.
*The Difficulty Skip Reward is only given after clearing the final boss zone,
and cannot be obtained during the mid-session calculation.
- You can instantly sweep tiers within a certain range below the highest tier currently cleared.
- The Algorithm of the Week is rotated every week.
- You can view how many Entry Codes you have remaining, which are required to enter the Simulation Gate.
*If you don't have enough Entry Codes, you will be able to enter in Practice Mode, but you will not be able to obtain the rewards while in Practice Mode.
- The number of Entry Codes you have for the Simulation Gate will be reset to the maximum amount during the weekly reset, regardless of how many you currently have.
[Simulation Gate Map]
- You can view the details of each Simulation Gate tier here.
- You can view Simulation Gate's Collection entries, code statuses, the number of points you are expected to obtain, and the current acquirable rewards at the bottom.
*You can check the current acquirable rewards any time on the Pause screen when entering the map or a stage.
- You can also view the active Algorithm of the Week.
- If you end the simulation without making any progress, the Entry Code you used will be returned.
*However, if there's progress, it will be recorded, and the Entry Code will not be returned.
[Simulation Gate Interaction]
- While playing stages in the Simulation Gate, you can obtain Collection Entries and Codes through battles and Episodes.
- You can use each of these virtual objects strategically to gain an advantage in battle.
- In the System Maintenance stage, you can use specific currency to increase the stats of your Collection Entries and Codes.
[Effect Amplification]
- You can view the Effect Amplification's activation tier and granted Amplification effect.
- Use Memory Chips you obtained as Simulation Gate Rewards as materials
to activate and receive the Amplification effect.
- When 2 or more can be activated, you can use the Quick Activation feature.
[Simulation Gate Calculation]
- When you end the simulation (calculating your results mid-session) while playing or clear the last boss zone
in the Simulation Gate, you can view the rewards you'll receive based on the result.
*The Difficulty Skip Reward is only given after clearing the last boss zone,
and cannot be obtained during the mid-session calculation.
*This guide was written based on the test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

blocks: A menu where you can further upgrade Legendary Skill Runes and Blessing Stones.
[How to Access Skill Research]
- [Menu] ▶ [Skill Research]
- [Lobby] ▶ [Management] (NPC May) ▶ [Skill Research]
- [Menu] ▶ [Sung Jinwoo] ▶ [Skill] ▶ [Skill Research]
- Unlocks when you register one or more Legendary Skill Runes or Blessing Stones.
[Synthesis Guide]
- You can select Legendary Skill Runes/Blessing Stones you want to synthesize.
*Rare and Heroic Skill Runes/Blessing Stones cannot be used as Synthesis Material.
- When selecting an item, you can check the synthesis conditions and material information for each synthesis.
*These will indicate whether the conditions are met before synthesizing.
*Only the items displayed as Synthesis Material will be consumed.
- When synthesizing, Synthesis Materials and Gold will be consumed.
- You can either manually select Legendary Skill Runes/Blessing Stones to use as material, or you can use the Auto-Select feature.
- Items used as Synthesis Material do not need to be the same type as the synthesis target.
[Amplification Guide]
- You can choose which Transcendent Skill Rune or Blessing Stone to amplify from your collection.
- Once an item is selected, you can view its amplification conditions, required material info, and the amplification result.
- You can use other copies of the same Skill Rune / Blessing Stone as amplification materials.
*Amplification materials (Skill Rune / Blessing Stone) are consumed only upon successful amplification and kept if the attempt fails.

- Amplification Agents and Gold, excluding amplification materials, are consumed each time you attempt amplification regardless of the result, and using more than the minimum required Amplification Agents increases the chance of success.
*The max Success Rate from additional Amplification Agents varies depending on the Amplification Tier.
(Depending on the Amplification Tier, even using the maximum number of Amplification Agents may not guarantee a 100% success rate.)
*The Success Rate increase per Amplification Agent varies depending on the Amplification Tier.
*Buff effects (like skill damage increases or stat increases) that increase through the Amplification Effect are not applied in the Battlefield of Time.
Additional effects are granted based on the Amplification Tier. The conditions for each item's effects are as follows:
*Skill Rune: Effects are applied only while equipped
*Blessing Stone: Effects are always active as long as you own them
*This guide was written based on the test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

blocks: This game mode allows you to overcome challenges and tests prepared
by the Architect in sequence to grow stronger and earn various rewards.
[How to Access the Architect's Test]
- [Menu] ▶ [Game Modes] ▶ [Seasonal Missions] ▶ [The Architect's Test]
- [Lobby] ▶ [Compass] ▶ [Seasonal Missions] ▶ [The Architect's Test]
- Unlocks upon clearing Story Chapter 23 on Normal mode.
[The Architect's Test Guide]
- The available Trial Level, active Laws of the Architect, time remaining in this season, and your current progress can be viewed here.
Trial Level:
- Automatically set based on your current Battle Tier, but can be manually adjusted within a certain range.
- The Trial Level determines how difficult the Architect's Test dungeon will be to complete.
- However, the higher the Trial Level, the better the rewards.
- At higher Trial Levels, the Laws of the Architect may get tougher.
*Even if you change the Trial Level, you cannot earn additional Clear / Mission Rewards for tiers already claimed for this season.
Laws of the Architect
- You can view the battle rules set by the Architect for each Architect's Test season.
- The test tiers consist of a mix of Player / Hunter Mode.
- Clearing each tier allows you to challenge the next test.
- You can view the monsters and their Total Power for each tier.
You can obtain bonus rewards upon completing Reward Missions. Each time a new season begins,
your progress and Reward Missions will reset and you can play from the beginning.
*This guide was written based on the test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

blocks: You can dispatch Shadow Enforcers on missions to claim various rewards.
[How to Access the Shadow Enforcer Feature]
- [Menu] ▶ [Shadow Enforcer]
- This feature is unlocked when Jinwoo's job becomes "Monarch of Shadows.
[Shadow Enforcer Guide]
- On the Shadow Enforcer page, you can check your mission progress and proficiency.

- Missions are divided into four categories: missions to stop crimes, missions to protect Jinwoo's allies, special tasks, and general missions. Missions can be carried out by assigning Shadows of the same type.
- A secret mission may be triggered when specific conditions are met or based on chance.
*Secret missions allow you to deploy all Shadows regardless of their class, and they operate separately from other missions,
regardless of the number of concurrent missions.
- Before starting a mission, you can set the Shadows you want to dispatch and the mission duration, then check what rewards are available for those settings.
*Dispatching more Shadows will increase the max mission duration.
- You can select an ongoing mission to check its progress or cancel it.
*If you cancel a mission, you will not receive any rewards from that mission. (Shadows from a cancelled mission can be dispatched again.)
- By increasing your Mission Proficiency you can earn Mission Points to level up, and higher Mission Levels unlock additional missions.
- Mission Proficiency is earned from missions in proportion to the completed mission duration.
- When the Proficiency gauge is full, the Proficiency tier increases.
- You can check the effects gained at each Proficiency tier.
*This guide was written based on the test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

blocks: In the Training Room, you and your hunters can train in various environments, allowing you to develop better strategies for real combat.
[How to Access the Training Room]
- [Lobby] ▶ [Training Room]
- [Menu] ▶ [Strategy Training] ▶ [Training Room]
[Training Room Guide]
In the Training Room, you can reset the combat, start or stop a timer, enable enemy AI, and load presets, allowing you to simulate a variety of scenarios.
1) Total Damage counter: Allows you to check the total damage you have dealt so far. This counter can also be reset.
*When the Timer feature is enabled, only the total damage during the timer period will be tracked.
2) Training Room Settings: You can practice battles in diverse environments by adjusting the Training Room Settings, such as enemies, the timer, and other settings.
*You can change up to two icons displayed in the Favorites feature in Settings.
*Training room settings can be changed in the Pause menu.
3) Reset Battle: You can reset the battle to its initial state.
4) Timer: You can set the timer.

5) Recommended Skill Use Order (Hunter Mode only): The Combo Guide for the character in play can be turned on or off. You can also go to Training Room Settings > Other Settings to turn detailed Combo Guide options on or off.
6) Enable Enemy AI: The deployed enemy AIs can be enabled or disabled.
7) Load Preset: You can easily load a formation saved in your preset.
*Selecting Restore Default Formation from the preset list will revert the formation to the one set when first entering the Training Room.
[Training Room Key Bindings]
- By going to the [Menu → Settings → Control Settings] page in the game, you can assign Training Room-specific shortcuts.
- You can change up to two icons displayed in the Favorites feature in the Training Room Option.
(Enable Recommended Skill Use Order / Enable Enemy Attack Mode / Apply Enemy Break Gauge / Enable Timer, etc.)
*You can access it by clicking the Arrow icon on the right on the [Existing Common Shortcut Settings] page.
*This guide was written based on the test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

blocks: In the Overseer's Forbidden Library, hunters appear as protagonists to conquer stories selected by the Overseer, claiming various rewards and growing.
[How to Access The Overseer's Forbidden Library]
- [Lobby] ▶ [Compass] ▶ [Seasonal Missions] ▶ [The Overseer's Forbidden Library]
- [Menu] ▶ [Game Modes] ▶ [Seasonal Missions] ▶ [The Overseer's Forbidden Library]
- Unlocks upon clearing Story Chapter 23 on Normal Mode.
- On the Overseer's Forbidden Library page, you can view current notices, rules, eligible elements, and reward details.
- The Overseer's Forbidden Library rules rotate on a seasonal basis.
- Rewards reset and can be obtained each season.
*If a season ends during a stage, rewards up to the stage reached are delivered to your mailbox.
[The Overseer's Forbidden Library]
- You can check the prepared story shelf (stage) in the Overseer's Forbidden Library.
- Review the characters and Total Power required for each tier, then select and enter your desired tier.
*Characters: Refers to hunters available for use in the Overseer's Forbidden Library. Once selected as a protagonist, they can be deployed and utilized in battle.
- You can personally select Characters from the list of hunters you own.
- Selected Characters are eligible to become Protagonists, appearing in the story through a selection process.
- A minimum number of Characters must be selected. Selecting more than the required number grants specific effects for each additional hunter.
- Once selected, the Character's equipment settings such as artifacts and cores will be saved and cannot be changed.
*The information is saved temporarily for use during the Forbidden Library challenge.
*The save is removed once all the stories are cleared or when the story ends, allowing you to change the information.
*This method saves the information at the time of the challenge, allowing the player to change the information in modes outside the Forbidden Library.
(However, changes will not be reflected in the hunter formation for the Forbidden Library currently in progress.)
- After finalizing the Character selection, you can select the first Protagonist to appear in the story chosen by the Overseer.
- The Overseer's Bookmark hunter changes each season. Even if you don't own the hunter, you can use a trial version in battle.
- In the Overseer's Forbidden Library, all hunters are treated as possessing all elements.
*You can form your team freely without the usual restrictions based on elements.
- After completing a stage, you can select some of the randomly presented Characters to add to your roster of Protagonists.
- You can view the current status of Protagonist and Characters through View Protagonists.
- Upon clearing certain stages, a new path presented by Itarim of [Observation] allows you to restore Relevance, gain a buff, or exchange Protagonists.
1. A Verse Unwritten: Select a Protagonist to restore 1 Relevance.
2. Codex of Wishes: Gain a buff effect based on the conditions shown.
3. Switched Protagonist: Swap one of three random Characters for a Protagonist.
[The Overseer's Forbidden Library Calculation]
- Upon clearing the final story or ending a story in progress (mid-session calculation), you can view rewards based on the results.
- Stage Clear Rewards can only be claimed once per season, regardless of the tier (difficulty). (Stage Rewards are identical regardless of difficulty level.)
*However, higher difficulties allow you to challenge more advanced stages and earn greater rewards.
*This guide was written based on a test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

blocks: In Hunter Co-Op Training, achieve two growth objectives to earn additional effects to strengthen your hunters.
[How to Access Hunter Co-Op Training]
- [Menu] ▶ [Co-op Training]
- Unlocks upon clearing Story Chapter 23 on Normal mode.
[Hunter Co-Op Training]
- On the Hunter Co-Op Training page, you can check the training progress and effects for each element/class.
- The training effects you earned are applied to hunters of the matching element and class.
- Training becomes available when you have enough required material to begin training, or can craft the materials instantly.
- Complete training to improve the training effects.
- You can check the effects and required materials for each tier.
- You can train the selected categories all at once.
- You can view the materials required to train for all categories. Categories that have reached the target level will be excluded from training.
- In the Hunter Training info area, you can check the details of the currently applied effects.
[Hunter Co-Op Training Reset]
- Here, you can reset the Hunter Co-Op Training progress.
- Resetting consumes a set amount of currency, and you can preview the items that will be returned.

blocks: Edge of Illusion and Dreams is a co-op mode where players form parties through matchmaking to take on bosses.
[How to Access Edge of Illusion and Dreams]
- [Menu] ▶ [Game Modes] ▶ [Seasonal Missions] ▶ [Edge of Illusion and Dreams]
- [Lobby] ▶ [Compass] ▶ [Seasonal Missions] ▶ [Edge of Illusion and Dreams]
- Unlocks upon clearing Story Chapter 10 on Normal mode.
[Edge of Illusion and Dreams]
- Here, you can view the boss information, rules, World Nightmare Liberation Progress, time remaining in the season, and reward details.
- In the boss information section, you can check the boss's Total Power, recommended elements, and more.
- This is the current number of entry tickets available to enter the stage.
- 5 Entry Tickets are replenished for free each week during the season. (Tickets are not replenished during the off-season.)
*If you already have the max number of entry tickets, you can get extra by purchasing extra tickets in the shop or get them from events.
*Free tickets only go up to the max limit, and no additional tickets are given if you've already exceeded the limit.
- Each difficulty can only be attempted within your Battle Tier level bracket (min - max).
*You can take on the challenge once you meet the minimum requirements, but it's not available if your Battle Tier max level is above the max.
- When selecting a difficulty, you can select the Challenge Mode and decide if you want to use an entry ticket.
*Rewards are only granted when clearing a stage using an entry ticket; no rewards are given for free entries.
[Select Challenge Mode]
- Challenge Mode lets you pick from Random Matchmaking, Create Waiting Room, Join Waiting Room, or Join Guild Room.
- Random Matchmaking: You'll be automatically matched with random players to play.
- Create Waiting Room: You can create a new waiting room to play with specific players.
*When creating a waiting room, a unique entry code is generated, and you can also set a password.
- Join Waiting Room: Enter a shared entry code to join the waiting room.
- Join Guild Room: You can view and join a list of waiting rooms created by your guild members.
[Edge of Illusion and Dreams Reward]
- Rewards are divided into Co-Op Reward and Clear Reward.
- Co-Op Reward: Co-Op Points accumulated from world players who defeat bosses can be earned each time a World Nightmare Liberation tier is completed.
*However, rewards are only granted if you clear the stage using an entry ticket during the season.
*Unclaimed Co-Op Rewards will be sent to your mailbox after the season ends.
- Clear Reward: Rewards are granted immediately when clearing the stage using an entry ticket.
*This guide was written based on the test version of the game, and the content may change in the future.

blocks: You can make cores even more powerful by defeating Thoughtform Bosses. They have taken on the appearance of certain hunters.
[How to Access the Mind Rift]
- [Menu] ▶ [Game Modes] ▶ [Mind Rift]
- [Lobby] ▶ [Compass] ▶ [Mind Rift]
- Unlocks upon clearing Story Normal Chapter 18.
[Mind Rift Guide]
- The Mind Rift can be played in Sung Jinwoo Mode or Hunter Mode.
- Dungeon Entry Keys are deducted each time you clear a dungeon, and the menu will show you how many you have remaining.
- Dungeon Entry Keys are replenished for free every day and additional keys can be purchased at the shop.
*If you purchase additional keys from the shop or obtain extra keys through events while already having the max number of keys, you can hold more than the max limit.
*Free keys only go up to the max limit, and keys aren't replenished if you've already exceeded the limit.
[Conquest Missions]
- You can obtain rewards based on the number of times you cleared the Mind Rift.
- When rewards are reset, the rewards may change depending on your Battle Tier Level.
[Detailed Mind Rift Guide]
- You can learn more about the Mind Rift here.
- You can reviewing the boss details for any given tier to plan a strategic combat formation.
- You can obtain additional rewards by clearing the Battle Missions.
- The rewards you can obtain by clearing the dungeon are listed in this menu as well.
- Rewards for clearing the Mind Rift include artifacts and material items.
- When you clear a stage of the Mind Rift, you'll obtain the rewards and the number of keys you have will be reduced.
- You can sweep stages in tiers which have had all their Battle Missions cleared.
[Reward Settings Guide]
- You can select a type of core to claim as a reward.
- You can view each core's details here.

blocks: Successors are characters who inherit the powers of a Monarch, and depending on the play mode, act as either a playable character or a powerful supporter.
Strengthen your Successors to unleash even more powerful and overwhelming Monarch abilities on the battlefield.
[How to Access Successors]
- [Menu] ▶ [Legacy] ▶ [Successors]
- Unlocks upon clearing Story Chapter 11 on Normal mode.
[Successors Guide]
- Successors are synced to Jinwoo's level and advance simultaneously with him.
- Select each Successor on the Successors page to view their level, specs, and skill info.
[Succession]
- You can activate or enhance succession effects through the Draw.
*You can only enhance successions that have been activated.
- Succession includes Exclusive Weapons / Artifacts / Skill Growth / Upgrades, and the selected Successor advances according to the enhancement tier of each component.
- Tap on the magnifying glass icon displayed on the succession level to view the current succession status.
- You can reset selected succession growth using certain currency in Succession Details.
[Successor Usage/Formation]
- You can assign Successors or Remnant Power to formations through Special Formation on the character formation page.
*They cannot be used in certain game modes such as Edge of Illusion and Dreams or International Clash (PVP).
- Total Power is applied upon assigning Successors and is added into the Team Total Power.
- In Battle Class, the Total Power of whichever is higher between a Monarch's Remnant Power and their Successor is applied.
- After setting Successors, they operate differently based on the play mode.
*Sung Jinwoo Mode: You can use Successors as playable characters on the battlefield by tagging out with Sung Jinwoo.

blocks: Complete various Card Missions to earn card packs. Collect seasonal cards from card packs, complete sets, and earn a variety of rewards.
[How to Access the Cards]
- [Menu] ▶ [Cards]
[Seasonal Cards]
- Seasonal Cards are available on a seasonal basis.
- Cards are divided into 1 to 5 stars and can be obtained by opening card packs earned through Card Missions and other sources.
- Earn Set Completion Rewards each time you collect all the required cards to complete a set.
- Earn tiered Collection Rewards based on the total number of cards collected during the season.
- When you obtain a duplicate card, it's converted into star-shaped Card Points equal to its star grade, which are then accumulated.
*Accumulated Card Points can be exchanged for various items at the Exchange Shop.
- When the season ends, all cards owned from that season and accumulated Card Points will be reset
- Obtaining duplicate cards you already own will earn Loyalty separately from Card Points.

- Loyalty accumulates independently based on season and Star Rank. Once the required conditions are met, drawing a card of that season and Star Rank guarantees an unowned card from the opened Card Pack thereafter.
- Loyalty for the relevant season and Star Rank will reset upon acquiring an unowned card of that Star Rank or when the season ends.
- If you already own all cards of the relevant season and Star Rank, the unowned card guarantee will not apply.
- Cards from previous seasons may be difficult to obtain once their respective seasons have ended.
- Unclaimed Collection Progress Rewards will be sent to your mailbox.
[Collection Book]
- The Collection Book lets you view all the cards you've collected at a glance, regardless of season.
- When you obtain a card for the first time, it's automatically registered in the Collection Book.
- Even if your Seasonal Card collection is reset at the end of a season, your card collection records in the Collection Book will be preserved.
- You can freely customize the frames of cards in your Collection Book using frames you own.
