blocks: The Hall of the Monarchs is a game mode where you can test your limits by defeating more powerful Workshop of Brilliant Light bosses and aiming for a high score.
[How to Access the Hall of the Monarchs]
- [Menu] ▶ [Game Modes] ▶ [Seasonal Missions] ▶ [Hall of the Monarchs]
- [Compass] ▶ [Seasonal Missions] ▶ [Hall of the Monarchs]
*Unlocks when clearing Workshop of Brilliant Light Tier 10 in Sung Jinwoo Mode.
[Hall of the Monarchs]
- On the main screen, you can view detailed information for each floor, including recommended elements, boss info, rankings, and rewards.
- No entry currency is required, and you can retry as many times as you like.
- The Hall of the Monarchs operates on a seasonal basis, with bosses that previously appeared in the Workshop of Brilliant Light randomly selected to appear each season.
- There are three floors in total, and each new floor unlocks after you clear the previous one.
- Cleared floors can be challenged again, and your high score will be updated if you achieve a higher score than your previous record.
*The unlock status of each floor resets at the start of each new season.
[Proof of Mastery]
- Enemies become stronger based on the Proof of Mastery settings selected. In exchange for the increased difficulty, you can earn more bonus points.
- When retrying a floor, your Proof of Mastery settings from the previous attempt are retained, making it easier to take on the challenge at a higher difficulty.
[Rankings and Rewards]
- Your ranking is determined by the combined score from all three floors available during the season.
- Even if you clear only one floor, your score will be immediately reflected in the rankings.
Season Ranking: Your ranking is determined by your combined score across all three floors, and rewards are granted based on the rank you achieve.
Guild Ranking: A rank board where guild members can compare scores and compete against each other.
*No separate Guild Rank Rewards are awarded, and the feature is unavailable if you are not in a guild.
Season Rank Reward: Rewards can be claimed at the start of the next season after the previous season’s results have been finalized.

[Deep Containment Zone Info]
- The Deep Containment Zone is a weekly boss challenge where you form a team of four hunters and a Legacy (Successor or Remnant Power) slot.
- You can check the featured experiment boss's element, passives, and special rules that apply each week, such as Anomaly Reports.
- A difficulty is recommended based on your Total Power, but you can also adjust it manually.
- The dungeon's element and Anomaly Report effects change with each weekly reset.
- Multiplay is available, allowing you to consume additional Deep Containment Zone Keys to increase the number of rewards earned in a single playthrough.
- Deep Containment Zone Keys are deducted each time you clear a dungeon, and the menu will show you how many you have remaining.
- Deep Containment Zone Keys are replenished for free every week and additional keys can be purchased at the shop.
*If you purchase additional keys from the shop or obtain extra keys through events while already having the max number of keys, you can hold more than the max limit.
*Free keys only go up to the max limit, and keys aren't replenished if you've already exceeded the limit.
[Team Formation and Union System]
- Form a team of four hunters and choose either a Successor or Remnant Power for your Legacy slot.
- The new Union ability is activated when you form a team of four hunters of the same element.
- Fill the gauge during combat to activate Union, unleashing a powerful exclusive skill and granting special buffs based on the classes of the hunters in your team.
*Union can only be used once per battle, so it's important to activate it at the right moment.
*You can view detailed information about Union activation effects for each class on the Formation screen.
[Reward Info]
- Clear the Deep Containment Zone to earn growth materials.
- The rewards you can obtain vary depending on the difficulty level.
- Rewards are granted immediately on the Battle Results screen.
